en: I think it's probably enough too.
zh: 我觉得这也差不多够了。

en: now we're gonna get some chicken.
zh: 现在我们要去买点鸡肉。

en: let's go this way.
zh: 我们走这边吧。

en: all right, I typically go with chicken breast tenderloins.
zh: 我通常会选鸡胸里脊肉。

en: because they're leaner and not too expensive at Costco.
zh: 因为它们脂肪少，而且在 Costco 也不算贵。

en: 3.29 per pound. seven pounds of this I'll probably go through in a week.
zh: 每磅3.29美元，我一周大概会吃掉七磅。

en: I'll meal prep like three and a half pounds.
zh: 我会做三磅半的预制餐。

en: which will come out to about 70 grams of protein per meal.
zh: 这样每顿大约能有70克蛋白质。

en: I'm also gonna get bell peppers for that.
zh: 我还要买彩椒来搭配。

en: I think I forgot to get bell peppers.
zh: 我好像忘记拿彩椒了。

en: let's go grab bell peppers.
zh: 去拿点彩椒吧。

en: but yeah I typically do like a very similar meal prep
zh: 对，我平时基本都做差不多的预制餐。

en: like chicken, rice, bell peppers, onions.
zh: 比如鸡肉、米饭、彩椒、洋葱。

en: and it's just easy to make and it's high in protein and good macros (macronutrients).
zh: 这样做起来简单，而且蛋白质含量高，营养也比较均衡。

en: can't forget the bell peppers. 6.89 for six.
zh: 彩椒可不能忘了。6个卖6.89美元。

en: it's not like ideal.
zh: 价格不算特别理想。

en: but I think it's better than a standard grocery store if you got them at like Aldi or something.
zh: 但我觉得比普通超市，比如 Aldi，买的要划算些。

en: and the quality is pretty good of the ones at Costco.
zh: 而且 Costco 的彩椒质量还不错。

en: Alright now we're on to eggs.
zh: 好了，现在我们去买鸡蛋。

en: the weekly question now is are they gonna have eggs.
zh: 现在每周都要问的就是：还有鸡蛋吗？

en: they haven't had them the past couple Sundays here at this Costco.
zh: 这家 Costco 连续几个星期天都没鸡蛋了。

en: eggs have been really expensive because of the bird flu.
zh: 因为禽流感，鸡蛋最近特别贵。

en: and when I eat five a day it's kind of cooked to be honest.
zh: 我每天吃五个鸡蛋，说实话这成本挺高的。

en: I should honestly think about having my own chickens at some point.
zh: 说真的，我得考虑哪天自己养鸡了。

en: obviously not yet because I don't have my own place.
zh: 当然现在还不行，因为我还没有自己的房子。

en: I think they're out of eggs. Ah man we're gonna have to go somewhere else.
zh: 看样子这儿的鸡蛋卖光了。唉，我们得去别的地方看看了。
